title: Switch
text: Switch output between first input and third input based on value of second input, 3 inputs, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations; {Criteria for passing first input} sets the selection criteria to pass first data input u2 >, {Threshold}, {Enable zero-crossing detection}, {Require all data port inputs to have the same data type} requires data ports to have the same data, {Output minimum} sets the minimum output value for range checking, {Output maximum} sets the maximum output value for range checking, {Output data type}, {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action and {Allow different data input sizes}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: First data input signal scalar | vector

ports.name: Port_3
ports.summary: Second data input signal scalar | vector

params.values: Selection criteria to pass first data input u2 > Threshold (default) | u2 >= Threshold | u2 ~= 0
